preregistered_criteria.pass_condition: The fingerprint is architecture-conditional if, for at least two of the three systems, turning off its bottleneck: (1) changes that system's dominant-stage share by >= 20 percentage points (e.g. semantic F1 share falls by >= 0.20), and (2) the within-system Stuart-Maxwell p < 0.05 survives Holm across the three tests.
preregistered_criteria.fail_condition: The fingerprint is architecture-independent if all three knobs leave the dominant-stage share within +-10 points and no within-system test is significant.
preregistered_criteria.between: Anything between is reported as partial and the claim is narrowed to the systems/conditions where the stage moved.

A1.knob: raw-write verbatim storage (removes the fact-extraction bottleneck)

note: A2 (summary raw-context) is deferred; the smoke showed its stage does not move because context assembly, not summary lossiness, binds. With two evaluated conditions at most one can pass, so the pre-registered 'at least two of three' rule cannot be satisfied until A2 or A4 runs.
